answer: The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. Each of 447 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A librarian professional registration is the credential: a registration the institute renews after catalogued years. Watch the beacon: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the echo bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the relic audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
